patches.name: Spotify branding
patches.description: Renames MySpoti to Spotify and replaces every launcher, themed, supporter-preview, splash, widget, and notification mark with Spotify branding.

patches.name: MySpoti Export & Storage
patches.description: Adds Export & storage to Settings > Downloads in MySpoti 2.3.0 in both Classic and Immersive looks, matching MySpoti's Immersive glass, grouped surfaces and selected accent; includes local-first playback for downloaded tracks, tagged audio exports, offline lyrics resolution/cache, portable LRC and JSON lyrics, embedded lyrics, playlist/album M3U8 manifests, reinstall restoration into native Downloads and lyrics caches, shared track files and offline storage migration.
